_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `mimo acp` 0.1.15 (npm @mimo-ai/cli, linux-arm64) driven over stdio by a probe client. The model was served through a loopback LiteLLM proxy (1.105.1) in front of Amazon Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5, named to the harness as an openai-compatible provider `probe/probe-model`, so `cost` reads 0. `MIMOCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` is the seed Kiro Crew builds for a Side Chat session (acp/harness/mimocode.py `_mimocode_routing_config` with `_mimocode_seed_denies` of a `side_read_only` session): `"*": "ask"` and a `deny` for every tool in `MIMOCODE_SIDE_DENIED_TOOLS`, plus `memory.disable_write`; no MCP server. `mimo debug config` on that seed left every side deny in force, judged with Crew's own read-back helpers. Asked to read a file, grep and glob by absolute path, then to create a file and to run `touch`: `read` (kind read), `grep` and `glob` (kind search) each asked before running, with the target path in the call's arguments (`read` names it on the in_progress update before the permission request, `grep` and `glob` on the request); no write and no shell tool was offered, so no file was created, and the model listed only read, glob, grep and webfetch as its tools. Reductions: session, message and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the probe's working directory written as /work/mimo-proj, an absolute path as the harness sent it; the `model` select cut to its current value; available_commands_update dropped; consecutive agent_message_chunk frames of one message folded into one frame. `agentInfo.name` is the harness's own answer: the fork still reports `OpenCode`. The glob result's lines under the harness's own bundled package tree in `.mimocode` are cut from the completed frame; the project files it listed are kept.
